description.en: Excess internal heat, prone to heatiness

quote.en: Feeling the heat? Don't let little things ruin your mood 🔥
quote.zh: 最近火氣有點旺，別讓小事燒掉你的好心情🔥

advice.en: A red tongue often indicates excess heat in the body. Cooling and yin-nourishing foods help restore balance.
advice.zh: 舌紅多與體內熱盛有關，適合選擇清涼、養陰的食物，幫助降火平衡。

benefitText.en: Calms the mind and reduces internal heat to restore inner peace.
benefitText.zh: 清心安神，能緩解心煩焦慮，並有助於降低體內虛火。

benefitText.en: Nourishes Yin and moistens dryness to soothe the respiratory system.
benefitText.zh: 滋陰潤燥，專門滋養肺部與喉嚨，修復因乾燥引起的不適。

benefitText.en: Clears heat and detoxifies the body from accumulated toxins.
benefitText.zh: 清熱解毒，是夏季消暑、排除體內熱毒的經典食療。

quote.en: Your energy seems low — warm foods and rest will help 🛌
quote.zh: 看起來有點虛，不妨多補充溫暖食物與休息🛌

advice.en: A pale tongue is often linked to qi and blood deficiency. Warm, spleen-strengthening foods can improve vitality and circulation.
advice.zh: 舌淡白常與氣血不足有關，適合溫補、健脾的食物，幫助提升體力與循環。

benefitText.en: Tonifies Qi and nourishes blood to enhance energy levels.
benefitText.zh: 補氣養血，能提升氣色並增強脾胃能量。

benefitText.en: Nourishes the liver and improves vision for eye health.
benefitText.zh: 養肝明目，對長期用眼過度及肝腎陰虛有良好的補益作用。

benefitText.en: Strengthens the spleen and kidney to support digestive health.
benefitText.zh: 健脾補腎，性質溫和，能強健消化系統並固腎益精。

quote.en: Feeling heavy? Try herbal tea to clear the damp ☁️
quote.zh: 濕氣卡住了你？試試去濕茶，讓身體清爽點☁️

advice.en: A thick white coating often indicates dampness in the spleen and stomach. Foods that drain dampness and promote digestion are recommended.
advice.zh: 舌苔白厚多與脾胃濕重有關，適合健脾化濕、利水的食物。

benefitText.en: Drains dampness and promotes urination to reduce swelling.
benefitText.zh: 利水滲濕，有助於排除體內多餘水分，消除浮腫。

benefitText.en: Aids digestion and promotes smooth movement of Qi.
benefitText.zh: 助消化，能順氣消食，緩解腹脹不適。

benefitText.en: Clears heat and promotes urination to flush out excess heat.
benefitText.zh: 清熱利尿，透過增加代謝排尿來帶走體內的積熱。

quote.en: Watch out for heatiness! Cool down with light meals 🍵
quote.zh: 小心上火！多吃清熱食物，給自己降溫🍵

advice.en: Linked to internal damp-heat. Choose foods that clear heat and remove dampness.
advice.zh: 多與濕熱有關，適合清熱去濕食物。

benefitText.en: Clears heat and relieves summer heat, ideal for cooling the body.
benefitText.zh: 清熱解暑，能瀉火除煩，特別適合火氣大時食用。

benefitText.en: Clears heat and detoxifies to protect against heat-related fatigue.
benefitText.zh: 清熱解毒，強效排除體內暑氣與毒素。

benefitText.en: Strengthens the spleen and regulates Qi to reduce bloating.
benefitText.zh: 健脾理氣，能燥濕化痰，讓脾胃運作更順暢。

description.en: Stomach yin deficiency, qi deficiency, general weakness
description.zh: 胃陰虛、氣虛、身體較虛弱

quote.en: Running low? Time to recharge with rest and nutrients 💧
quote.zh: 最近有點累過頭，記得放慢腳步，補充營養💧

advice.en: A peeled tongue coating is often related to stomach yin deficiency. Gentle, yin-nourishing foods are ideal.
advice.zh: 舌苔剝落多與胃陰不足有關，適合滋陰養胃、溫和補養的食物

benefitText.en: Generates body fluids and moistens dryness to relieve thirst
benefitText.zh: 生津潤燥，潤肺止咳，是補足身體水分的佳品

benefitText.en: Nourishes Yin and moistens the lungs for deeper hydration
benefitText.zh: 養陰潤肺，口感更潤，能清心除煩並滋潤呼吸道

benefitText.en: Strengthens the spleen and nourishes the stomach for easy digestion
benefitText.zh: 健脾養胃，極易消化，是病後或脾胃虛弱者的補品

quote.en: Stress shows — sleep early and cut the salt 🌙
quote.zh: 壓力太大會水腫喔，早睡和少鹽可以幫你消腫🌙

advice.en: Teeth marks on the tongue are often related to spleen deficiency and excess dampness. Foods that strengthen the spleen and drain dampness are beneficial.
advice.zh: 有齒痕多與脾虛、體內濕氣重有關，適合健脾利濕的食物。

benefitText.en: Drains dampness and promotes urination to reduce swelling
benefitText.zh: 利水滲濕，有助於排除體內多餘水分，消除浮腫

benefitText.en: Strengthens the spleen and removes dampness from the body
benefitText.zh: 健脾祛濕，側重於補血與代謝下肢水腫

benefitText.en: Warms the middle burner and expels dampness and cold
benefitText.zh: 溫中祛濕，透過溫熱性質發汗散寒，驅除體內寒濕

description.en: Fluid deficiency, stress-related heat or internal heat
description.zh: 體液不足、壓力大或內熱

quote.en: Your tongue tells what your heart hides — be kind to yourself 💬
quote.zh: 你內心的疲憊悄悄顯現在舌頭上，該好好愛自己了💬

advice.en: A cracked tongue is often associated with yin deficiency or lack of body fluids. Choose yin-nourishing and fluid-generating foods.
advice.zh: 舌有裂紋多與陰虛或體液不足有關，適合滋陰養津的食物

benefitText.en: Nourishes Yin and moistens dryness for skin and hair health
benefitText.zh: 滋陰潤燥，能潤腸通便並滋養頭髮與肌膚

benefitText.en: Nourishes Yin and generates fluids to replenish collagen-like moisture
benefitText.zh: 養陰生津，含有豐富膠質，能滋潤全身乾燥組織

benefitText.en: Clears heat and generates fluids to rapidly hydrate the body
benefitText.zh: 清熱生津，能快速補給水分並緩解口乾舌燥

description.en: The system could not detect a tongue in the image.
description.zh: 系統在影像中未偵測到舌頭。

quote.en: Please make sure your tongue is clearly visible in the photo.
quote.zh: 請確保舌頭在照片中清楚可見。

advice.en: Try taking the photo again in good lighting, stick out your tongue naturally, and keep the camera steady.
advice.zh: 請在光線充足的環境下重新拍攝，自然伸出舌頭並保持相機穩定。
